entries.statement: For the general real binary k=2 chain with independent node laws, C_2^P(eta)=1 for 0<eta<=1.

For the declared finite-dimensional real binary k=2 class with arbitrary bounded bilinear laws, shared or independent, orthogonal proper projectors, and unit leaves, the normalized class-level constant is C_2^P(eta;A)=1 for 0<eta<=1.
limitations: Higher-arity k=2 variants, infinite-dimensional attainment, broader gated-planar repeated-law subclasses, novelty, and human review remain open.

entries.statement: For the explicitly defined repeated law mu_A(x,y)=A*x*<e0,y> with active planar contraction ||A||<=M and ||(I-P)A P||<=rho=eta*M, the normalized k=2 projected-root constant is exactly 1; the exact error is ||P A (I-P) A e0||.
limitations: This closes the declared contractive gated subclass, not variable-gate, arbitrary-leaf, or non-planar shared-law variants.

entries.statement: The earlier eta^2 construction remains valid only for the narrower repeated gated-planar law family.
The k=2 projected-bound equality conditions are compatible for independent or repeated laws in the declared finite binary-chain class.
For the declared independent-law k=3 binary chain witness, the certified lower bound is E_proj=2 M q sqrt(M^2-q^2), with q=min(rho,M/sqrt(2)).
limitations: This is a construction lower bound, not global sharpness.

entries.statement: For the declared independent-law k=3 binary branching witness, the same certified lower bound is achieved by a separate branching construction.
limitations: This is a construction lower bound, not global sharpness.

entries.statement: For the explicitly declared real binary same-map class, C_2,same-law^P(eta)=1 for 0<eta<=1; the narrower gated-planar repeated-law family still has normalized value eta.
limitations: The gated-planar repeated-law subclass remains open for fixed-eta global sharpness.

entries.statement: The V5-A witness family has the exact normalized lower curve L3(eta)=2*sqrt(1-eta^2) for eta<=1/sqrt(2), and L3(eta)=1/eta for eta>1/sqrt(2).
limitations: Exact for the declared witness family; not a global fixed-eta upper bound.

entries.statement: For the declared independent-law k=3 class covered by the V5-A lower witness and the universal projected bound, lim_{eta downarrow 0} C_3,ind^P(eta)=2.
limitations: Asymptotic eta->0 result only; fixed-eta global sharpness remains open.

entries.statement: For the declared gated-planar rotation construction, E_proj(eta)=eta^2 and the universal projected-root bound is saturated iff eta=1.
For every finite ordered full-binary topology under the declared homogeneous gated-planar rotation law, E_proj=|a(T)cos(d(T)theta)-cos(theta)^k| with recursive a,d invariants.
limitations: Restricted homogeneous gated-rotation family; no global independent-law sharpness claim.

entries.statement: For every finite ordered rooted tree with arities at least two under arity-compatible homogeneous gated-planar rotation laws, the recursive a,d formula gives the exact projected error.
limitations: Restricted arity-compatible law; no arbitrary-law or global extremal claim.

entries.statement: ambient same-law-bound saturation inside a broader gated-planar repeated-law subclass

Every fixed finite typed tree admits an evaluation-preserving support compression with dim(W_tau)<=2*(leaf_count_tau+2*node_count_tau), and k=3 binary chain/branching classes have a 20-dimensional one-type bound (22 with proper-projector padding).
limitations: No single dimension bound is claimed for unbounded tree size/arity or beyond the type-indexed projector convention.

entries.statement: dimension/rank reduction beyond fixed finite trees and the typed-projector convention
global k=3 topology-specific sharpness beyond the independent-law binary chain and branching classes
theorem-level novelty
fixed-eta universal scalar reduction for the V5-B k=3 candidate envelope
entries.note: The old scalar-reduction attempt was not proved; M9 supplies a different unconditional envelope.

entries.statement: For every fixed finite dimension/rank class, M10 non-attainment implies a positive class-dependent strict gap below U_3(eta) for 0<eta<1.
limitations: No dimension/rank-uniform gap is proved.

entries.statement: Under first-propagator operator-norm saturation in the ordered k=3 chain, the conditional normalized bound is sqrt(4-3 eta^2) below sqrt(2/3) and 2/(sqrt(3) eta) above.
limitations: Conditional saturation hypothesis; not an unconditional fixed-eta global sharpness result.

entries.statement: Historical strict-gap corollary for independent-law binary k=3 chain and branching classes below U_3(eta).
entries.historical_statement: For independent-law binary k=3 chain and branching classes, C_3,ind^P(eta)<U_3(eta) for every 0<eta<1 after finite-support compression and compactness.
limitations: The current exact constants W_3 for both declared topologies replace this nonquantitative formulation; broader same-law/gated and arbitrary-tree classes remain open.

entries.statement: For finite typed multilinear DAGs with finite labelled sources, node errors admit exact finite multi-index source polynomials; same-source first-order paths aggregate before norm; truncation has a norm-weighted remainder bound; and finite signed expressions satisfy B_actual <= B_signed <= B_treewise.
limitations: Finite declared DAGs only; scalable implicit-DAG compression, infinite-series tails, universal signed-forest sharp constants, and novelty remain open.

entries.statement: Historical endpoint strict-gap corollary below U_3(1) for independent-law binary chain and branching classes.
entries.historical_statement: At eta=1, M10 non-attainment plus fixed-tree compactness gives C_3,ind^P(1)<U_3(1)=sqrt(2) for independent-law binary chain and branching classes.
limitations: The exact endpoint value is now 2/sqrt(3) for both declared topologies; broader classes remain open.

entries.statement: For the independent-law ordered binary k=3 chain, the unconditional normalized constant satisfies C_3,ind,chain^P(eta)<=W_3(eta), where W_3=sqrt(4-3 eta^2) for eta<=sqrt(2/3) and W_3=2/(sqrt(3) eta) above; moreover W_3<U_3 on 0<eta<=1.
limitations: This is the chain upper-bound component; the exact value is supplied by V5-K3-CHAIN-EXACT-001. It does not address broader same-law/gated or arbitrary-tree classes.

entries.statement: For the independent-law ordered binary k=3 chain, C_3,ind,chain^P(eta)=W_3(eta), with W_3=sqrt(4-3 eta^2) for eta<=sqrt(2/3) and W_3=2/(sqrt(3) eta) above; a dimension-two rank-one witness attains the bound.
limitations: Same-law/gated subclasses, fixed-eta independent-law k>=4, growing-tree uniformity, novelty, and human review remain open.

entries.statement: For the independent-law ordered binary k=3 branching tree, C_3,ind,branch^P(eta)=W_3(eta), with the same piecewise formula; nuclear/operator-norm duality supplies the upper bound and a dimension-two rank-one witness attains it.
limitations: Same-law/gated subclasses, fixed-eta independent-law k>=4, growing-tree uniformity, novelty, and human review remain open.

entries.statement: For the finite-dimensional binary k=3 class with independently selectable node laws and no law-sharing constraint, the class-level normalized constant equals W_3(eta) for both ordered chain and branching topologies.
limitations: Repeated same-law/gated subclasses, higher-arity or arbitrary finite topologies, growing-tree sharpness, novelty, and human review remain open.

entries.statement: For every fixed finite ordered full-binary tree T with k internal vertices, lim_{eta downarrow 0} C_{T,ind}^P(eta)=k-1; the two-dimensional real-plane witness (identified with C) has E_proj=|sin((k-1) arcsin(eta))|.
limitations: Asymptotic eta downarrow 0 only; fixed-eta equality, higher arity, same-law/gated variants, growing-tree uniformity, novelty, and human review remain open.

entries.statement: For every fixed finite ordered rooted tree T with all internal arities at least two, lim_{eta downarrow 0} C_{T,ind}^P(eta)=k(T)-1; the real-plane witness (identified with C) has E_proj=|sin((k-1) arcsin(eta))|.
limitations: Asymptotic eta downarrow 0 and fixed finite trees only; fixed-eta equality, same-law/gated sharpness, growing-tree uniformity, novelty, and human review remain open.

entries.statement: For every fixed finite ordered rooted tree T with all internal arities at least two, lim_{eta downarrow 0} C_{T,ind}^P(eta)=k(T)-1; the real-plane witness (identified with C) has E_proj=|sin((k-1) arcsin(eta))|.
limitations: Asymptotic eta downarrow 0 and fixed finite trees only; M20 now closes fixed-eta independent-law k=3, while same-law/gated sharpness, k>=4 fixed-eta sharpness, growing-tree uniformity, novelty, and human review remain open.

entries.statement: For every finite ordered rooted tree T with exactly three internal vertices and all internal arities at least two, the independent-law fixed-eta projected-root constant is C_{T,ind}^P(eta)=W_3(eta) for 0<eta<=1. Freezing unit leaf slots reduces the two possible internal-child skeletons to the M14 chain or M15 branching class, and unit e0 gates embed the matching witnesses.
limitations: Same-law/gated variants, fixed-eta independent-law k>=4, growing-tree uniformity, novelty, and human review remain open.

entries.statement: For binary k=3 chain and branching classes with one repeated bilinear law, a finite orthogonal direct-sum construction using projected leaf tags simulates the M14/M15 witnesses. The tagged same-law constants therefore equal W_3(eta) for every 0<eta<=1.
limitations: Rank-one/common-leaf same-law restrictions, gated/variable-gate subclasses, fixed-eta independent-law k>=4, growing-tree uniformity, novelty, and human review remain open.

entries.statement: For the strict binary k=3 chain with one repeated gated rotation, common unit projected leaf e0, and rank-one projector span(e0), the class constant equals W_3(eta)=2/(sqrt(3) eta) for sqrt(2/3)<=eta<=1.
limitations: The low-eta rank-one/common-leaf same-law chain, rank-one/common-leaf branching, broader gated/shared-law variants, fixed-eta independent-law k>=4, growing-tree uniformity, novelty, and human review remain open.

entries.statement: For the strict binary k=3 chain with one repeated bilinear law, common unit projected leaf e0, and rank-one projector span(e0), the projected error is exactly |<e0,A^3e0>-<e0,Ae0>^3| for A(x)=mu(x,e0); every finite-dimensional contraction A is realized by the gated repeated law mu_A(x,y)=A x <e0,y>.
limitations: Exact reduction only; the low-eta extremal value, rank-one/common-leaf branching, and broader same-law/gated variants remain open.

entries.statement: exact fixed-eta values for same-law/gated k=3 classes and independent-law trees with k>=4 internal vertices
Beyond the M19 finite-tree asymptotic result, fixed-eta equality and uniform growing-tree independent-law sharpness remain conjectural.

For finite multilinear DAGs with declared operator, normal-residual, and leaf-domain enclosures, the topological recurrence certifies root error with shared subexpressions charged by slot and fan-out multiplicity; rank-independent enclosures yield an exact finite rank-budget dynamic program.
limitations: Finite declared DAGs and finite rank tables only; certificate enclosures are not asserted sharp or universally valid when empirically estimated; independent human review and novelty review remain pending.

entries.statement: For a fixed rank assignment on a finite multilinear DAG with declared exact-value, projected-operator, normal-residual, and leaf-domain enclosures, the rank-aware recurrence using projected values and mixed max(U,A) factors certifies root error on shared subexpressions and repeated slots.
limitations: Rank-aware allocation is coupled and optimized exhaustively only for small DAGs; no scalable allocator or sharpness claim; independent human review and novelty review remain pending.

entries.statement: For finite acyclic nonnegative first-order DAG channel recurrences, the exact root constant is the sum of local source bounds weighted by all source-to-root path products, with shared fan-out and parallel repeated slots counted multiplicatively.
limitations: Sharpness is exact only for the declared nonnegative first-order channel class; simultaneous sharpness of the original multilinear operator class remains open, as do novelty and independent human review.

entries.statement: For the fixed independent-law shared diamond DAG with one shared projected node, two projected branches, and an unprojected root, the normalized asymptotic constant as eta downarrow 0 is exactly 4; the planar complex-multiplication witness has error |exp(4 i arcsin(eta))-cos(arcsin(eta))^4|.
limitations: Fixed topology and asymptotic eta downarrow 0 only; fixed-eta equality, arbitrary-DAG sharpness, same-law/gated variants, novelty, and independent human review remain open.

entries.statement: For every fixed finite ordered acyclic independent-law multilinear DAG with unit leaves, rank-one real projections at non-root internal nodes, and unprojected root, the normalized asymptotic constant as eta downarrow 0 equals K(G), the total projected source-to-root slot-path multiplicity.
limitations: Fixed finite DAGs and asymptotic eta downarrow 0 only; no fixed-eta equality, unbounded-DAG uniformity, same-law/gated sharpness, novelty, or independent human review claim.
